messages:
julia: quick personal update — two things! i accepted a promotion to Senior Product Manager today 🎉 and also closed on a tiny house near the park. totally exhausted but so excited :heart_eyes:
sam: OMG congrats!!! two huge wins in one week?! we demand a celebratory toast 🥂 :tada:
mike: absolutely massive, julia. housewarming + promo party when? cake? i volunteer to bring a sad-looking plant and make it thrive 😂
anya: congrats congrats congrats!!! chocolate cake pls. i can bring decorations and confetti (real confetti?) :confetti_ball:
people-ops-bot: reminder: if you haven’t yet, update your job title in the internal directory and file the promotion paperwork here: https://redwood.internal/hr/promo (automated)
julia: thanks everyone!! planning a small housewarming next saturday afternoon — will post an RSVP link tomorrow. not expecting gifts but low-light plant recs appreciated 🌿. also moving boxes saturday morning if anyone wants to help, pizza and beer on me 🍕
sam: i’ll bring pizza. and i have an extra set of shelves if you need them — modular and boring in a good way.
mike: i can lend a hand with the move and a van if needed. pm me the time.
anya: i’ll sign up for cake. chocolate with raspberry filling? (low-key fruit makes it classy)
julia: chocolate+raspberry sounds perfect. thanks y’all. also — people-ops, if there’s a short blurb we should share in #general for the promo, i’m happy for you to post it, otherwise sam said he’ll do a shoutout :thumbsup:
sam: i’ll do a quick shoutout tomorrow morning. congrats again julia!! :sparkles::clap:
mike: big love <3
anya: :party_parrot: :heart:
